title: Synced attribute keys missed on 1.21+
releases: 1.21-1.21.11, 26.1 (audit scope; 26.2 and 26.3 read the same way)
note: The corrected minecraft-data gives a resource equal to the protocol mapper's key on 1.20.5-26.3 (checked with a data query), but the tests build their keys through attributeKey and the adapter replay stores both bare and namespaced names, so nothing exercises the mismatch itself.

title: Depth Strider and Soul Speed read from the wrong slot

evidence.regression: takes Depth Strider from the highest armor piece, not from the fields of mineflayer-physics-utils; takes Soul Speed from the boots and Swift Sneak from the leggings alone

note: Fixed through the bot's inventory; the entry's feet-only statement is wrong because vanilla reads every armor slot (ALL_ARMOR), and the replay seeds the level so q_depth_strider_* does not reach this read.

title: 1.8-1.9 farmland collides as a full cube

evidence.code: minecraft-data pc/1.8 and pc/1.9 blockCollisionShapes farmland; src/mineflayer/blocks.ts:boxesAt

note: The data now gives the full cube on 1.8 and 1.9 and 15/16 from 1.10; the recording exists only under E:/mc-physics-demo/minecraft-physics-native/recorder/out/recordings, not in the minecart set, so it is not counted as executed vanilla and 1.8.8 rests on 1.8.9 source.

title: Trident has no in-ground state
note: The trident now takes the arrow's in-ground branch; the recording is confirmed on 26.3 with status ok, and no release before 1.20.5 is in the minecart set.

title: Pre-1.15 stepOn runs for a flying player
note: apply_block_effects still has no flying test, while vanilla's stepOn sits inside canClimb(), which is false for a flying player.

title: 26.3 containsAnyLiquid scans inclusive cells
scope: client/player and ridden mob/fluid hop free-space test
note: contains_any_liquid still scans floor(min)..ceil(max) exclusive on every release, so a box max on a whole number leaves out the column 26.3 includes.

title: 1.20.5 attributes unresolved on 1.20.5-1.20.6
note: attributesByName now holds gravity, stepHeight, jumpStrength, scale and safeFallDistance on 1.20.5 and 1.20.6, but the named tests that read those keys run on 1.21+ or 26.3 and the fix commit in the data checkout could not be identified.

title: Pre-1.13 projectile ray trace used modern walk

evidence.vanillaSource: net/minecraft/world/World.java:882-1008 and net/minecraft/util/math/Box.java:294-368 (1.12.2, cited by the audit)

note: The stepped walk and six-face intercept exist before 1.13; 1.13.2 still uses traverseBlocks, which the finding itself rates as rarely visible, and 1.8.8 rests on 1.8.9 source.

title: 26.2 and 26.3 climbable and resetting tags empty
note: Both tables now hold the nine climbables and cobweb plus sweet berry bush, and the recorded fall into a cobweb reaches the clip through the release's tag.

title: 1.8.8 ladder box thickness
note: The data now gives the 0.125 box; the recording exists only under the main checkout's recorder/out/recordings, not in the minecart set, and 1.8.8 rests on 1.8.9 source.

title: 1.8.8 lily pad box
note: The data now gives the full-width 1/64 box; the recording exists only under the main checkout's recorder/out/recordings, not in the minecart set, and 1.8.8 rests on 1.8.9 source.

title: Piston move limited to zero skips block effects
note: move_by_piston still returns before its effects when the limited amount is zero, while vanilla runs applyEffectsFromBlocks after move() whatever the move did.

title: 1.13 getWaterLevelAbove adds y inside the max
note: water_level_above has no 1.13 branch, and vanilla 1.13.2 takes max(f, y + height) so a water layer at y >= 1 counts as full.

title: 1.13 boat scans use the water-above height
note: water_height still returns world.fluid_height_at from 1.13, which applies the same-fluid-above rule that 1.13.2's worldless method_17810 does not have.

title: Ridden horses and camel skip the extra inside-block pass
note: The second check_inside_blocks pass is still limited to pigs and striders, while the horse branch calls tryCheckBlockCollision on every steered tick.

title: Fluid currents never push projectiles
note: The base tick now pushes by water and lava current in the in-world tick path; no recording with a flowing current was found (pj_snowball_through_water is not one), and the entry's lava start was not re-read from source here.

title: Bubble columns never push arrows or hurting projectiles
scope: client/arrow, trident, fireball family, shulker bullet
note: push_by_bubble_column is still reached only from the thrown-item path, while vanilla's arrow, hurting projectile and shulker bullet ticks all apply block effects.

title: Arrow start-of-tick containment check missing
releases: 1.14.4-26.3 (velocity reset 1.21.5-26.3; 1.8.8-1.13.2 via the stored hit block)
note: arrow_tick now sets in_ground from the position inside a collider and clears the motion from 1.21.5, gated by release as the entry describes.

title: 1.14-1.16.1 throwables clip outlines
scope: client/thrown items and llama spit/block_hit via adapter world sync
note: The no-collider half is fixed by f912371, but a block with a collider still gets its collision box as outline from the adapter, so a fence or wall clips at 1.5 instead of its 1.0 outline.

title: Pre-1.14 projectiles clip the wrong block shape
scope: client/arrows, thrown items, fireballs, llama spit/block clip
note: Traversal is fixed by D-168 but arrows still pass ClipShape::Collider, while 1.13.2 clips the outline of blocks that have a collision shape and 1.8-1.12 clip the selection box.

title: Trident loyalty return not modelled
note: The return is modelled with owner and loyalty inputs on the hit-state entry point; the plain tick_trident_in_world path has no owner and stays put.

title: isImmobile not modelled
note: The tick clears jump and x/z input for a dead or sleeping player; ps_sleep_scale_2 and m_death_respawn exist but were not shown to hold movement input while immobile.

title: Boats and ridden mobs never add fallDistance
note: Ridden mobs accumulate since B184, but vehicle.rs still never adds to a boat's fall_distance, while vanilla's Boat.fall does when it is not over water.

title: Non-local entity still gets landing velocity update
note: B151 gated the piston bounce only: the slime bounce, its fall reset and the y*0 branch still run whatever controlled_by_local_instance says, which only direct N-API callers reach.

title: Ground jump reset fall_distance
note: The jump branch no longer writes fall_distance, and the test holds a state that jumps with fall distance kept.

title: Landing computed damage at fall_distance 0
note: The damage now sits behind fall_distance > 0, but no test or recording stands on the ground with a negative safe fall distance or on a dripstone tip with a lowered one.

title: Ceiling hit over slime resets fall distance
note: bounced still keys on y_collision without on_ground and still writes fall_distance = 0, though the fall_damage clear in the entry is gone.

title: Landing block misses fence, wall and gate exception
note: Recording files exist with status ok in the 26.3 index, and the case exercises the support-block rule at default attributes.

title: Riptide lift missing from movementThisTick
note: old_position is taken after the lift and movements_this_tick holds only the tick's own move, so blocks only the pre-lift box touches are still not swept.

title: 1.21.4 traversal keeps the 1e-7 nudge
note: box_traverse_blocks applies the nudge to every release below 1.21.5, while 1.21.4 walks the plain box corner.

title: 1.13.2 water snap uses pre-move falling flag
note: going_down is still taken before the move on every release, while 1.13.2 tests the post-drag velocityY.

title: 1.14 spectator sneak input slowed then undone
note: isMovingSlowly has no spectator test on 1.14, so the input is slowed and undone to 1.0 where vanilla never slows and ends longer; the source read is 1.14, not exact 1.14.4.

title: Flight-start jump used max from 1.20.5
scope: client/player/adapter flight toggle on the ground

evidence.regression: sets the rise before 1.21.2, and keeps a faster one from it; stops at no power, and halves on honey at the x and z of the block that supports it

note: The rise is set outright before 1.21.2 and the jump factor reads the supporting block's x and z at y-0.500001, both tested on the adapter path.

title: Default movement speed is double 0.1
releases: all, direct N-API callers omitting movement speed
note: The default is still the double 0.1 where vanilla's base is 0.10000000149011612; the adapter sends f32(0.1) and is not affected.

title: 1.10-1.12 auto-jump obstacle order
note: Before 1.13 the engine still walks z, y, x, while World.method_13689 walks x, z, y and the first crossing box decides.

title: 1.10-1.12 auto-jump probes full collision shape
note: The probe still takes the max of the full collision boxes on these releases, while vanilla reads method_11726 (getCollisionBoundingBox) for one box.

title: Spectator in the sweep keeps the riptide spin
note: A spectator is sent as inert with its box and every kind counts as touched, so the wall end of the spin is still skipped where NO_SPECTATORS leaves the list empty.

title: Raw fireworkBoost added too late

evidence.vanillaSource: world/entity/LivingEntity.java:2337-2339 (26.3, cited in the code, not re-read)

note: The boost is now added at the start of the tick, before going_down and the jump read the motion.

title: Per-attempt block filter used strict intersects
note: Block shapes now pass through shape.meets with the merger tolerance on the listed and step-up queries, and the test reaches 5e-8 into a partial block.

title: Projectile inside test uses world coordinates
note: clip_block still tests bounds.contains(inside) in world space, while vanilla subtracts the block position before findIndex, a difference of about one ulp.

title: 1.8.8 piston head arm boxes
note: The data now keeps the arm inside the cell; the recording exists only under the main checkout's recorder/out/recordings, not in the minecart set, and 1.8.8 rests on 1.8.9 source.

title: 1.13.2 bed and cauldron shapes are 1.14's

evidence.code: minecraft-data pc/1.13.2 blockCollisionShapes white_bed, cauldron; src/mineflayer/blocks.ts:boxesAt

note: A data query shows the 1.13.2 tables still equal 1.14.4's legged shapes, and no override replaces them.

title: Generated state counts miss inherited properties

evidence.regression: resolves every state count the client reports from the release's own classes

note: chain 6, oak_fence 32, oak_stairs 80 and lantern 4 now match, and the test compares counts with each release's client.

title: Dying shulker or happy ghast still collides
note: The kind still comes from the name, baby and staysStill flags with no alive test, while vanilla's canBeCollidedWith needs isAlive.

title: Riptide check counts spectators
note: Same code, trigger and vanilla rule as D-197, counted once as active there.

title: Player carrying passengers still pushed
note: push_by_nearby_entities has no vehicle test on the player's side, and neither the state nor the adapter sends one, while vanilla pushes it only if !isVehicle().

title: 1.8 pushed-block area not normalised
note: draw_in edits the box in place with no sort, while the 1.8.9 Box constructor orders each axis; 1.8.8 rests on 1.8.9 source.

title: 1.21.5+ boat effect pass starts before the snap
note: old_position is still taken before float_boat and handed to movements_this_tick, so the recorded move starts at the pre-snap height.

title: Sitting camel in water does not stand
note: The camel arm only handles the dash and pose_time, with no in-water stand-up.

title: 26.3 fishing hook gravity and restitution
note: default_gravity_in now gives the float value (f912371), but the hook's move still passes gravity 0.0 to the restitution, whose bounce gate and compensation read getEffectiveGravity in 26.3.

title: Riptide lift ignores slime or bed on ceiling hit
note: The lift still sets velocity.y to zero on any vertical collision with no landing-block lookup; the entry's vanilla citations were not re-read, though the same rule holds in the tick's own move.

title: 1.16.2-1.17.1 suffocatesAt ignores the border offer
note: suffocates_at still tests blocks alone, while vanilla's spliterator offers the border shape first for a non-null entity; the only linked ticket B087 is closed, so this needs a new or reopened item.

title: 26.3 passengers skip closest-space push
note: The gate is now present at 26.3 and the test holds both sides of the release boundary.

title: Riptide launch runs after pre-player boosts and pushes
note: The scene still runs the rocket boost and pushes before the tick's launch_riptide, while handleKeybinds releases the trident before tickEntities.

title: Removed player skips the base tick
note: The early return still comes before the fluid push and lava halving, while vanilla removes during tickDeath after super.baseTick and skips only aiStep; the test removed_player_stops_its_move_after_the_collision_then_stops_moving_from_1_19_1 pins the engine's current form.

title: Generic state has no yaw in degrees
note: yaw_degrees is carried by the boat and horse states and NativePlayer, but the generic conversion still writes None; the Mineflayer path is correct and 1.8.9 source was not re-read.

title: Ridden-mob zero attributes replaced by defaults
note: The positive() fallback is gone from the N-API sources and the tests send a real zero through the conversion.

title: 1.9-1.12 eye height ignores the glide case
note: lowBox is still limited to 1.13 and the pose is not updated before 1.14, so a gliding 1.9-1.12 player gets 1.62F.

title: 1.13 fluid probe uses a pose-sized box
note: updateFluids still builds its box from state.pose, which stays standing before 1.14, and updateLegacyFluids does the same before 1.13, instead of the kept box.

title: In-water scan includes floor(max) cell
note: upper is ceil only for the 26.1+ interaction path and stays floor+1 before it, which adds a cell at an exact integer max where vanilla's ceil excludes it.

title: 1.19-1.20.4 rising guard with NaN
note: The guard is unchanged and a NaN velocity still enters through the packed input (napi_player.rs take_input), though normal play should not produce one.

title: 1.11 rocket before player boosts along head yaw
note: The engine uses state.look for every rocket and has no previous-yaw input, while 1.11.2's getRotationVector(1.0F) reads headYaw.

title: Adapter cancelled attached rocket off the glide
scope: client/player/adapter rocket count and duration path

evidence.regression: keeps an attached rocket through a pause in the glide, for the glide after it

note: The duration now only counts down and no longer drops to zero when the glide stops, and the test covers the pause and the glide after it.

title: Slow Falling gravity picked before the boost
note: Same ordering fault and fix as D-198, which already names the Slow Falling gravity sign.

title: 1.21.9+ corner walk step vector
note: walk_cells_while still derives signs and steps from to - from, the recomputed difference, while vanilla's addCollisionsAlongTravel reads deltaMove directly.

title: Boat waterLevel start value
note: The switch now sits at 1.17, but no test reads the reported value with no water found.

title: 1.19.3 refusing camel uses own input branch
note: The Camel arm has no 1.19.3 branch and returns zero input while refusing, where ignoresMovementInput sends vanilla to the non-controlled travel.

title: 1.17-1.21.1 riptide lift skips fire part of move
note: The lift still calls only apply_block_effects before 1.21.2, so the fire count and reset of its Entity.move do not run.

title: 26.3 elytra start read a stale lava flag
note: updateFluids now refreshes isInLava before the decision from 26.1, but the glide test sets the flag by hand and the fluid test does not start a glide, so no single test crosses a lava boundary.
